description: Chains, membership, the fork rule, cuts and checkpoints end to end (sections 4.4, 5.3, 6, 9).

vectors.name: group/lifecycle-roles
vectors.description: Genesis, a writer, a reader. A reader's record is ignored; a stranger's is ignored; after the reader is promoted within the same epoch the earlier record is accepted too, because the rule is "writer at some point in its epoch".

vectors.name: group/remove-with-cut-and-new-epoch
vectors.description: Bob writes twice on device b1 and once on device b2, then is removed with a cut that lists only (b1, seq 1) and an epoch record follows. Bob's b1 seq 1 is accepted; b1 seq 2 and 3, and every record on devices b2 and b3 (not in the cut), are beyond the cut; a record sealed in epoch 1 is ignored because bob is not a writer there.

vectors.name: group/removal-without-epoch-record
vectors.description: A removal that is never followed by an epoch record: the removal takes effect and is reported as pending an epoch (the spec says MUST follow, not what a reader does without it).

vectors.name: group/lower-writer-to-reader
vectors.description: A writer lowered to reader needs no new epoch; records beyond the cut are ignored.

vectors.name: group/invalid-membership-records
vectors.description: Eleven records that name the current head as mprev and are each invalid for a different reason; they are kept and ignored, and the one valid add continues the chain.

vectors.name: group/fork-removal-beats-smaller-id
vectors.description: Two managers name the same mprev: alice removes bob, bob adds carol. Bob's record has the smaller record id, but a record that removes the other's author wins.

vectors.name: group/fork-smaller-id-alice-smaller
vectors.description: Two managers add different people at the same mprev; neither removes the other, so the smaller record id wins (alice's). The loser and anything after it on its branch is ignored.

vectors.name: group/fork-smaller-id-bob-smaller
vectors.description: Two managers add different people at the same mprev; neither removes the other, so the smaller record id wins (bob's). The loser and anything after it on its branch is ignored.

vectors.name: group/fork-mutual-removal
vectors.description: Each manager removes the other at the same mprev. The spec's first clause makes both win; this implementation falls back to the smaller record id (finding).

vectors.name: group/fork-epoch-record-loses-to-add
vectors.description: Alice removes dave and writes the epoch record; bob concurrently adds erin with the removal as mprev. The smaller record id (bob's) wins, alice's epoch record is ignored and the removal is left without an epoch (finding).

vectors.name: group/genesis-equivocation
vectors.description: Two valid genesis records for one gid (same creator and nonce, written on two devices so that no chain is forked). The fork rule does not cover genesis; the group is reported as forked at the root (finding).

vectors.name: group/chain-fork
vectors.description: Bob's device b1 has two different records with seq 2. Both are kept, neither is accepted, and nothing later in the chain (seq 3) is accepted; seq 1 is. Alice's other chain is unaffected.

vectors.name: group/chain-gap-and-prev-mismatch
vectors.description: Bob's b1 chain is missing seq 2 (behind: seq 3 waits). His b2 chain has seq 2 whose prev is not the record the reader holds as seq 1 (waits as well).

vectors.name: group/held-back-future-clock
vectors.description: The reader's time is BASE_MS + 5 s: a record 24 hours and 1 ms ahead is held back, and so is the one after it (its chain then has a hole).

vectors.name: group/replace-secret-by-the-person
vectors.description: Bob replaces his own secret (signed with the old key) and alice writes the epoch record. The new pid takes the role. A later record written with the OLD key into the old epoch is still accepted, because kind 4 carries no cut (finding).

vectors.name: group/replace-secret-rules
vectors.description: A replacement naming a pid that is already a member, and one written by someone who is neither a manager nor the person, are ignored; a manager's replacement is valid.

vectors.name: group/checkpoint-full-history
vectors.description: Alice's items, a checkpoint by manager bob covering alice's chain up to seq 5 and his own first record, then later records. All records present: covered content is folded from the checkpoint, the rest on top.

vectors.name: group/checkpoint-covered-records-deleted
vectors.description: The same group after the covered content records (alice seq 3 to 5) were deleted from storage. Alice's membership record at seq 6 is only accepted because the checkpoint covers the gap, and the checkpoint is only valid because bob's role comes from records that survive. The state is unchanged.

vectors.name: group/checkpoint-by-non-manager
vectors.description: A checkpoint written by a writer (not a manager) is ignored and covers nothing.
